# obSCEne on PS5 hardware - the run where every import the platform has, bound
#
# Recorded: 2026-08-30. Console: PS5 at 192.168.1.211, system software 12.400.009, CFI-1116A.
# Result:   OBS|tally|232|75|192|29 over 528 checks in 30 sections, suite complete.
# Build:    BUILD_ID=global1, GEN=4, PROC_SDK=0, CALL_UNBOUND=0, the ten crashers excluded.
#
# ARTEFACT - one binary produced every line below.
#
# WHAT THIS ONE IS FOR: it carries the `import` records, which say per symbol whether the
# loader bound our import and whether a run-time lookup finds the same name in the same
# library. Those two axes separate "the platform does not have it" from "this module failed to
# ask for it correctly", and the second turned out to be fourteen of twenty cases.
#
# It is also the run *after* the repair. Every import was `STB_WEAK` undefined, which a loader
# reads as permission not to bother; re-binding them `STB_GLOBAL` took the repairable count
# from fourteen to zero and brought fourteen checks back. See docs/DECISIONS.md D248.
#
#   grep '^OBS|import|' | grep unlinked      the six the platform does not offer, and no more
#
# Libraries the run did not ask about emit no `import` record at all, because they end the
# process when loaded. Their absence here is a measurement not made, never a symbol not found
# (D245). `061-imports/unbound-import-is-callable` skips by build flag: asked once, the call
# did not return (D247).
#
